paragraphs: CompuMed provides tailored diagnostic telemedicine solutions built around the needs of individual healthcare sectors. One of those sectors is corrections, where the company specializes in correctional telemedicine to improve patient care, reduce liability, and eliminate unnecessary ER transports.

The company says it transforms diagnostic data into traceable, transparent and trustworthy insights. Cases move through a secure, cloud-based platform and advanced remote tools. A national network of board-certified sub-specialists delivers the expert interpretations. Cardiology work covers echo and ECG interpretation services for healthcare facilities.

The platform supports hospitals, urgent care centers, organ donation and transplant organizations, correctional facilities and government health systems. CompuMed is publicly traded, with stock under the symbol CMPD on the OTCPink exchange operated by OTC Markets.
